newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli troops wound 77 Palestinians - officials.
newsitem.headline: Israeli troops wound 77 Palestinians - officials.

text.p: Israeli soldiers shot and wounded at least 77 Palestinians with rubber bullets and live ammunition in West Bank clashes that erupted after a Jewish settler killed an Arab in Hebron on Tuesday, hospitals said.

Palestinian health ministry officials said 67 Arabs were treated at government-run Alia hospital, including one in critical condition who was taken to an Israeli hospital in Jerusalem. Ten other Palestinians received treatment at the private-run al-Ahli hospital, medics said.

Hundreds of stone-throwing Palestinians battled Israeli security forces across a line that divides Hebron into two areas of control after 24-year-old Asem Arafeh was shot dead by a Jewish settler near al-Ibrahimi mosque in the Israeli-controlled part of Hebron.
Witnesses said Israeli soldiers fired rubber bullets, metal-coated rubber bulets and live ammunition at the demonstrators who rained stones on them.

Hospitals said they were finding it difficult to cope with the large number of casualties being ferried in ambulances from the confrontation line. They said many of the wounded were already released after treatment while other remained for further observation.
